verses.en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.pt: Fiz o primeiro tratado, ó Teófilo, acerca de tudo quanto Jesus começou a fazer e ensinar,
verses.en_web: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
verses.en_bbe: I have given an earlier account, O Theophilus, of all the things which Jesus did, and of his teaching from the first,

verses.en: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.pt: até o dia em que foi levado para cima, depois de haver dado mandamento, pelo Espírito Santo, aos apóstolos que escolhera;
verses.en_web: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
verses.en_bbe: Till the day when he was taken up to heaven after he had given his orders, through the Holy Spirit, to the Apostles of whom he had made selection:

verses.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.pt: aos quais também, depois de haver padecido, se apresentou vivo, com muitas provas infalíveis, aparecendo-lhes por espaço de quarenta dias, e lhes falando das coisas concernentes ao reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And to whom he gave clear and certain signs that he was living, after his death; for he was seen by them for forty days, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God:

verses.en: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
verses.pt: Estando com eles, ordenou-lhes que não se ausentassem de Jerusalém, mas que esperassem a promessa do Pai, a qual (disse ele) de mim ouvistes.
verses.en_web: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
verses.en_bbe: And when they were all together, with him, he gave them orders not to go away from Jerusalem, but to keep there, waiting till the word of the Father was put into effect, of which, he said, I have given you knowledge:

verses.en: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.pt: Porque, na verdade, João batizou em água, mas vós sereis batizados no Espírito Santo, dentro de poucos dias.
verses.en_web: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
verses.en_bbe: For the baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit, after a little time.

verses.en: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.pt: Aqueles, pois, que se haviam reunido perguntavam-lhe, dizendo: Senhor, é nesse tempo que restauras o reino a Israel?
verses.en_web: Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
verses.en_bbe: So, when they were together, they said to him, Lord, will you at this time give back the kingdom to Israel?

verses.en: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes: A vós não vos compete saber os tempos ou as épocas, que o Pai reservou à sua própria autoridade.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, It is not for you to have knowledge of the time and the order of events which the Father has kept in his control.

verses.en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.pt: Mas recebereis poder, ao descer sobre vós o Espírito Santo, e ser-me-eis testemunhas, tanto em Jerusalém, como em toda a Judéia e Samária, e até os confins da terra.
verses.en_web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: But you will have power, when the Holy Spirit has come on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and all Judaea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

verses.en: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.pt: Tendo ele dito estas coisas, foi levado para cima, enquanto eles olhavam, e uma nuvem o recebeu, ocultando-o a seus olhos.
verses.en_web: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had said these things, while they were looking, he was taken up, and went from their view into a cloud.

verses.en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.pt: Estando eles com os olhos fitos no céu, enquanto ele subia, eis que junto deles apareceram dois varões vestidos de branco,
verses.en_web: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
verses.en_bbe: And while they were looking up to heaven with great attention, two men came to them, in white clothing,

verses.en: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.pt: os quais lhes disseram: Varões galileus, por que ficais aí olhando para o céu? Esse Jesus, que dentre vós foi elevado para o céu, há de vir assim como para o céu o vistes ir.
verses.en_web: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
verses.en_bbe: And said, O men of Galilee, why are you looking up into heaven? This Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come again, in the same way as you saw him go into heaven.

verses.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
verses.pt: Então voltaram para Jerusalém, do monte chamado das Oliveiras, que está perto de Jerusalém, à distância da jornada de um sábado.
verses.en_web: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
verses.en_bbe: Then they went back to Jerusalem from the mountain named Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

verses.en: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
verses.pt: E, entrando, subiram ao cenáculo, onde permaneciam Pedro e João, Tiago e André, Felipe e Tomé, Bartolomeu e Mateus; Tiago, filho de Alfeu, Simão o Zelote, e Judas, filho de Tiago.
verses.en_web: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came in, they went up into the room where they were living; Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas, the son of James.

verses.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.pt: Todos estes perseveravam unanimemente em oração, com as mulheres, e Maria, mãe de Jesus, e com os irmãos dele.
verses.en_web: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And they all with one mind gave themselves up to prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

verses.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.pt: Naqueles dias levantou-se Pedro no meio dos irmãos, sendo o número de pessoas ali reunidas cerca de cento e vinte, e disse:
verses.en_web: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
verses.en_bbe: And in those days Peter got up among the brothers (there were about one hundred and twenty of them), and said,

verses.en: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.pt: Irmãos, convinha que se cumprisse a escritura que o Espírito Santo predisse pela boca de Davi, acerca de Judas, que foi o guia daqueles que prenderam a Jesus;
verses.en_web: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, the word of God had to be put into effect, which the Holy Spirit had said before, by the mouth of David, about Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus,

verses.en: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.pt: pois ele era contado entre nós e teve parte neste ministério.
verses.en_web: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
verses.en_bbe: For he was numbered among us, and had his part in our work.

verses.en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.pt: (Ora, ele adquiriu um campo com o salário da sua iniquidade; e precipitando-se, caiu prostrado e arrebentou pelo meio, e todas as suas entranhas se derramaram.
verses.en_web: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness, and falling headlong, his body burst open, and all his intestines gushed out.
verses.en_bbe: (Now this man, with the reward of his evil-doing, got for himself a field, and falling head first, came to a sudden and violent end there.

verses.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.pt: E tornou-se isto conhecido de todos os habitantes de Jerusalém; de maneira que na própria língua deles esse campo se chama Acéldama, isto é, Campo de Sangue.)
verses.en_web: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
verses.en_bbe: And this came to the knowledge of all those who were living in Jerusalem, so that the field was named in their language, Akel-dama, or, The field of blood.)

verses.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.pt: Porquanto no livro dos Salmos está escrito: Fique deserta a sua habitação, e não haja quem nela habite; e: Tome outro o seu ministério.
verses.en_web: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell therein;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
verses.en_bbe: For in the book of Psalms it says, Let his house be waste, and let no man be living in it: and, Let his position be taken by another.

verses.en: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.pt: É necessário, pois, que dos varões que conviveram conosco todo o tempo em que o Senhor Jesus andou entre nós,
verses.en_web: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, of the men who have been with us all the time, while the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

verses.en: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.pt: começando desde o batismo de João até o dia em que dentre nós foi levado para cima, um deles se torne testemunha conosco da sua ressurreição.
verses.en_web: beginning from the baptism of John, to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
verses.en_bbe: Starting from the baptism of John till he went up from us, one will have to be a witness with us of his coming back from death.

verses.en: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.pt: E apresentaram dois: José, chamado Barsabás, que tinha por sobrenome o Justo, e Matias.
verses.en_web: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
verses.en_bbe: And they made selection of two, Joseph, named Barsabbas, whose other name was Justus, and Matthias.

verses.en: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.pt: E orando, disseram: Tu, Senhor, que conheces os corações de todos, mostra qual destes dois tens escolhido
verses.en_web: They prayed, and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
verses.en_bbe: And they made prayers and said, Lord, having knowledge of the hearts of all men, make clear which of these two has been marked out by you,

verses.en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.pt: para tomar o lugar neste ministério e apostolado, do qual Judas se desviou para ir ao seu próprio lugar.
verses.en_web: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
verses.en_bbe: To take that position as a servant and Apostle, from which Judas by his sin was shut out, so that he might go to his place.

verses.en: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.pt: Então deitaram sortes a respeito deles e caiu a sorte sobre Matias, e por voto comum foi ele contado com os onze apóstolos.
verses.en_web: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
verses.en_bbe: And they put it to the decision of chance, and the decision was given for Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven Apostles.
